attachments.origin_landmark: lower half of the nuchal ligament and spinous processes C7-T3
attachments.insertion_landmark: mastoid process and the lateral third of the superior nuchal line

actions: extends the head and neck bilaterally
rotates and laterally flexes the head to the same side

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Wraps the deeper neck muscles like a bandage -- splenion, a bandage. Unlike sternocleidomastoid it rotates the head to the SAME side, so the two are tested against each other.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
